burstCapturePredictions.method: Record continuous hold and individual trigger taps at 240 fps or higher, with ammo HUD and target impacts visible. Count accepted shots within each mode cycle. Timestamp shot events, input/trigger release and next accepted shot. Use same class, attachments, mode and loadout. For six enable-mode weapons, observed gap > 0 distinguishes engine cadence from current site model (which predicts no gap). Capture validates effective cadence/count only, not semantic names of anonymous WPM fields.
